solves.reasoning: Context says he used 'vivid' scenes and 'bright' colors and 'simplified' shapes — vivid/bright/simplified are positive descriptors consistent with his style. (A)vivid is correct, (B)bright is correct, (C)simplified is correct. Choice 2: vivid—bright—simplified

The Migration Series brought national recognition (not rejection). He served (not resigned) in Coast Guard. He received honorary (not mandatory) degrees. All three correct = option 4: recognition—served—honorary
Migration Series is his masterpiece (not manuscript). He produced (not purchased) paintings. He continued to explore (not exploit) lives. Choice 1: masterpiece—produced—explore
① vivid — correct (known for vivid scenes). ② dull — WRONG: passage says he used 'bright' colors, not dull. ③ recognition — correct. ④ honorary — correct. Answer: ②
① known — correct. ② simplified — correct. ③ taught — correct. ④ ceased — WRONG: passage says he 'continued to explore', not ceased. Answer: ④
① moved — correct. ② produced — correct. ③ preserved — WRONG: passage says most were 'lost', not preserved. ④ explore — correct. Answer: ③
The Migration Series brought him national ____. Context: it was his masterpiece bringing fame/recognition. Answer: recognition (③)
He served in the Coast Guard and _____ many paintings. Context: he was an active painter. 'produced' fits best. Answer: produced (①)
Until death he continued to _____ the lives of African-Americans. The passage says 'explore' — answer: explore (④)
Synonym of 'vivid' = striking/intense/bright. 'striking' (①) best matches vivid. 'faint', 'ordinary', 'unclear' are opposites.
Synonym of 'regarded' = considered/viewed/seen as. 'considered' (②) is correct.
Synonym of 'honorary' = ceremonial/given as honor. 'ceremonial' (①) best fits. 'compulsory' is opposite.
Antonym of 'simplified' = complex/elaborate/complicated. 'elaborate' (③) is correct. 'reduced' and 'basic' are synonyms; 'plain' is also similar.
Antonym of 'recognition' = obscurity/anonymity. 'obscurity' (②) is correct. 'fame', 'admiration', 'approval' are synonyms or related positive words.
(A) He served in the Coast Guard = 복무했다. (B) The waiter served us a meal = 제공했다. Answer: (A)복무했다—(B)제공했다 = ③
'a work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship' = masterpiece (②). Portrait/sketch/landscape don't fit this definition.
He used _____ shapes. (simple) → adjective form modifying noun = simplified
The Migration Series brought him national _____. (recognize) → noun form = recognition
He painted vivid scenes of African-American history and _____. Context: 'daily life' is in original passage. Korean choice: 일상생활 (①) = daily life
He received _____ from several universities including Harvard. Context: honorary degrees. Korean: 명예 학위 (④)
